title: Workers が TCP を受けられる！Containers の gRPC 双方向通信もパブリックベータに
summary: Workers への受信 TCP 接続と、Containers での双方向 gRPC がパブリックベータになったよ。Spectrum が公開 TCP 接続を Worker の connect() ハンドラーに渡して、Durable Object 経由で Container 内の gRPC サーバーにつなげるみたい！
title_en: Workers can now accept TCP! Bidirectional gRPC for Containers enters public beta
summary_en: Inbound TCP connections to Workers and bidirectional gRPC in Containers are now in public beta. Spectrum sends public TCP connections to a Worker's connect() handler, which reaches a gRPC server inside a Container through a Durable Object.
og_title: Spectrum, Containers, Durable Objects, Workers - Inbound TCP and gRPC for Workers and Containers now in public beta
